text:
Aisha (Support): FYI customer BrightCart just opened a ticket — p95/p99 for /v1/generate jumped suddenly ~10:58 UTC. They say tail latency went from ~120ms to 2.3s and it's affecting realtime UI. Can eng-sre take? :rotating_light:
Sam (eng-sre): on it. Do we have a tenant id or sample request?
Aisha (Support): tenant=brightcart-prod. They provided a small repro: many concurrent tiny prompts (1-8 tokens) hitting the route from a client-side polling loop. Said it started after a low-risk release earlier today. No errors, just slow responses.
Diego (runtime): looking at serving metrics now — global p99 for that route spiked at 10:57 UTC. Correlates with increase in small-request proportion. Continuous batcher metrics show average batch size down to 2-3 while batch_timeout_ms still at 50ms, so a lot of small batches waiting and causing tail.
Priya (infra): I also see a deployment to continuous-batcher v2 rolled at 10:45 by deploy-bot. Noticed a change: dynamic_window=true was toggled on. Could be related.
Sam (eng-sre): hmm. dynamic_window intended to improve throughput but with heavy tiny-request traffic it can extend wait windows. That would raise p95/p99. Can you dump the route config for brightcart-prod?
Diego (runtime): pasted route config snippet:
```
route: /v1/generate
tenant: brightcart-prod
continuous_batcher:
  enabled: true
  target_batch_size: 8
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  batch_timeout_ms: 50
  dynamic_window: true
```
Sam (eng-sre): ok. Two levers for quick mitigation: lower batch_timeout_ms for that tenant/route, or disable dynamic_window for them. Lowering timeout reduces tail but increases compute overhead.
Nate (Support): customer needs a temporary fix asap. They prefer latency over cost.
Priya (infra): I can push an emergency config change for that route. Propose: set batch_timeout_ms=10 and dynamic_window=false for tenant brightcart-prod.
Sam (eng-sre): +1. Also add a fast fallback: if average batch size < 3 for >30s, route should auto-fallback to direct single-request path. We can enable it as a canary.
Diego (runtime): I'll prepare commands. Emergency patch via Console API:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://console.internal.redwood/api/v1/routes/brightcart-prod" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"continuous_batcher": {"batch_timeout_ms": 10, "dynamic_window": false}}'
```
Sam (eng-sre): apply it. Ops-bot, open an incident ticket for tracking.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-20260314-8427, severity P2, linked to BrightCart ticket #3821.
Priya (infra): patch applied at 11:06 UTC. Monitoring...
Diego (runtime): seeing p99 drop starting at 11:06. Now p95 ~140ms and p99 ~320ms for that tenant. BrightCart reports UI back to normal.
Aisha (Support): Customer confirmed improved response times. They say UI latency is back to expected. Marked as acknowledged. :thumbsup:
Sam (eng-sre): good. Root cause notes: dynamic_window + large batch_timeout_ms produced longer waiting windows when traffic shifted to lots of tiny requests. Continuous batcher heuristics mis-tuned for this workload.
Nate (Support): customer asked for follow-up: can we keep a safer default for dynamic_window rollout?
Sam (eng-sre): action items:
- Diego: add a safety gate in runtime: if percent_small_requests > 60% then cap window to min(10ms, config.batch_timeout_ms).
- Priya: revert default dynamic_window=true in the rollout and add canary targeting (10% tenants) with telemetry.
- Nate / Aisha: follow up with BrightCart and offer config guidance (disable batching client-side or increase client-side aggregation).
Diego (runtime): I'll open a PR with the safety gate and a unit test simulating tiny-request floods.
Priya (infra): will rollback dynamic_window default in the deployment config and schedule a gradual re-release after validation.
Sam (eng-sre): also adding a dashboard panel to highlight small-request ratio per tenant and automated alert if p95 > 500ms and small-request-ratio > 50%.
Aisha (Support): thanks all — closing thread once follow-ups are queued.
deploy-bot: rolled config patch to brightcart-prod at 11:06 UTC (sha: a3f9b2).
